title: Crescent
description:
Crescent consider the body as a ritual site, positioned between the human (flesh) and the spiritual (symbol). Its translucent lunar form appears part vestment and part organism.

Material choices and concept converge within the same layered structure: a rigid and translucent outer shell  encloses shimmery soft matter, revealing a second form contained beneath the surface. This tension between containment and visibility shapes the work’s ceremonial language, centred on the coexistence of forces.

Realised in 3D-printed clear resin with silicon infill.
